    name: reference anti-VM strings
    namespace: anti-analysis/anti-vm/vm-detection

      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com

      static: file
      dynamic: file
    att&ck:
      - Defense Evasion::Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion::System Checks [T1497.001]

      - https://github.com/LordNoteworthy/al-khaser/blob/master/al-khaser/AntiVM/Generic.cpp

      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 17-02.dll_

    - or:
      - string: /HARDWARE\\ACPI\\(DSDT|FADT|RSDT)\\BOCHS/i
      - string: /HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\(SystemBiosVersion|VideoBiosVersion)/i
      - string: /HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\CentralProcessor/i

      - string: /SYSTEM\\(ControlSet\d{3}|CurrentControlSet)\\Control\\SystemInformation\\SystemManufacturer/i

signature_matches.name: parse PE header
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: parse PE header
    namespace: load-code/pe
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: unsupported  # requires mnemonic, operand[1].offset features
    att&ck:
      - Execution::Shared Modules [T1129]
    examples:
      - 9324D1A8AE37A36AE560C37448C9705A:0x403DD0
  features:
    - and:
      - os: windows
      - and:
        - mnemonic: cmp
        - or:
          - number: 0x4550 = IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE (PE)
          - and:
            - number: 0x50
            - number: 0x45
        - or:
          - number: 0x5A4D = IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE (MZ)
          - and:
            - number: 0x4D
            - number: 0x5A
        - optional:
          - and:
            - operand[1].offset: 0x3C = IMAGE_DOS_HEADER.e_lfanew
            - or:
              - and:
                - arch: i386
                - operand[1].offset: 0x50 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage
                - operand[1].offset: 0x34 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.OptionalHeader.ImageBase
              - and:
                - arch: amd64
                - operand[1].offset: 0x50 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage
                - operand[1].offset: 0x30 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64.OptionalHeader.ImageBase
          - basic block:
            - and:
              - operand[1].offset: 0x3C = IMAGE_DOS_HEADER.e_lfanew
              - 3 or more:
                - operand[1].offset: 0x4 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.FileHeader.Machine
                - operand[1].offset: 0x6 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.FileHeader.NumberOfSections
                - operand[1].offset: 0x14 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader
                - operand[1].offset: 0x16 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.FileHeader.Characteristics
                - operand[1].offset: 0x28 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint  # for 32 and 64 bit
                - or:
                  - and:
                    - arch: i386
                    - operand[1].offset: 0x34 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.OptionalHeader.ImageBase
                    - operand[1].offset: 0x50 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage
                  - and:
                    - arch: amd64
                    - operand[1].offset: 0x30 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS.OptionalHeader.ImageBase
                    - operand[1].offset: 0x50 = IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage

signature_matches.name: stealth_network
signature_matches.description: Network activity detected but not expressed in monitor API logs
AV process strings found (often used to terminate AV products)
Queries the volume information (name, serial number etc) of a device
PE /OLE file has a valid certificate with Microsoft as Issuer
Sample file is different than original file name gathered from version info
Runs a DLL by calling functions
PE file has a high image base, often used for DLLs
Contains modern PE file flags such as dynamic base (ASLR) or NX
Sigma detected: Potential Persistence Via COM Hijacking From Suspicious Locations
match_data: Data: Details: C:\Users\user\Desktop\vmswitchmigrationplugin.dll, EventID: 13, EventType: SetValue, Image: C:\Windows\System32\regsvr32.exe, ProcessId: 6196, TargetObject: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\

signature_matches.description: May sleep (evasive loops) to hinder dynamic analysis
PE file contains a valid data directory to section mapping
Binary contains paths to debug symbols
Checks if the current process is being debugged
PE file contains sections with non-standard names
URLs found in memory or binary data
Sample execution stops while process was sleeping (likely an evasion)
Binary contains device paths (device paths are often used for kernel mode <-> user mode communication)
PE file contains a mix of data directories often seen in goodware
Sample tries to load a library which is not present or installed on the analysis machine, adding the library might reveal more behavior
May try to detect the virtual machine to hinder analysis (VM artifact strings found in memory)
match_data: VMware Virtual disk SCSI Disk Device
